full_citation: Juhas M (2015) Pseudomonas aeruginosa essentials: an update on investigation of essential genes. Microbiology 161(11):2053-2060.
notes: Tier6 review. PMID 26311069; PMCID PMC10960635. Discusses PAO1 annotation, MPAO1 (Lee) on six media incl. CF sputum, PA14 (Liberati MAR2xT7). Use for intro/discussion and to locate primary datasets; do not extract labels from the review.

full_citation: Turner KH, Wessel AK, Palmer GC, Murray JL, Whiteley M (2015) Essential genome of Pseudomonas aeruginosa in cystic fibrosis sputum. PNAS 112(13):4110-4115.
medium: CF sputum / SCFM2 / MOPS-sputum vs MOPS-succinate minimal
notes: Tier3. PMID 25775563; PMCID PMC4386324. CORRECTION: contains DIRECT PAO1 fitness data ('Wild-type PAO1...'; 'in both PAO1 and PA14'). PAO1 rows usable without orthology; PA14 rows need B-MAP-01. Supplement 403-blocked (B-NET/B-LIT-01).

full_citation: Lee SA, Gallagher LA, Thongdee M, Staudinger BJ, Lippman S, Singh PK, Manoil C (2015) General and condition-specific essential functions of Pseudomonas aeruginosa. PNAS 112(16):5189-5194.
notes: Tier2. PMID 25848053; PMCID PMC4413342. MAJOR CORRECTION: parent strain is MPAO1 ('The P. aeruginosa parent strain was MPAO1'), a PAO1 derivative -> directly usable for PAO1 validation (record MPAO1 sublineage caveat). Manoil lab. Supplement 403-blocked (B-NET/B-LIT-01).

full_citation: Poulsen BE, Yang R, Clatworthy AE, White T, Osmulski SJ, Li L, Penaranda C, Lander ES, Shoresh N, Hung DT (2019) Defining the core essential genome of Pseudomonas aeruginosa. PNAS 116(20):10072-10080.
notes: Tier3/5. PMID 31036669; PMCID PMC6525520. Multi-strain core essential (~321 across strains). PAO1 is one analyzed strain; PAO1-only list usable IF separable in supplement (unverified). Code github.com/broadinstitute/FiTnEss.

full_citation: Basta DW, Bergkessel M, Newman DK (2017) Identification of fitness determinants during energy-limited growth arrest in Pseudomonas aeruginosa. mBio 8(6):e01170-17.
medium: minimal medium + 40 mM pyruvate; C- or O2-limited growth arrest
notes: Tier4. PMID 29184024; PMCID PMC5705914 (erratum 10.1128/mbio.00576-18). CONFIRMED PA14 ('the PA14 wild-type strain'; 'UCBPP-PA14 genome'). Requires validated PAO1<->PA14 orthology (B-MAP-01). Growth-ARREST survival != growth essentiality; keep class distinct.

full_citation: Belanger CR, Dostert M, Blimkie TM, Lee AHY, Dhillon BK, Wu BC, et al., Hancock REW (2022) Surviving the host: microbial metabolic genes required for growth of Pseudomonas aeruginosa in physiologically-relevant conditions. Front Microbiol 13:1055512.
notes: Tier1. PMID 36504765; PMCID PMC9732424. CORRECTION: explicitly PAO1 ('saturated transposon insertion mutant pool of P. aeruginosa strain PAO1'). Directly usable for PAO1 host-condition fitness validation once supplement obtained. Hancock lab, 2022-11-25.
